review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The mutation replaces a conditional guard that checks whether an 'activate' action is being performed with a mismatched base_state_version (triggering revalidation) with the literal `if False:`, which unconditionally disables the entire branch. Any code within the original conditional block will now never execute, regardless of the values of `action`, `revalidate_state`, `assertion.base_state_version`, or `base_version`. This produces an observable behavioral difference whenever all three original conditions would have evaluated to True: activation requests with revalidation enabled and a version mismatch will no longer trigger the guarded behavior (e.g., state revalidation, error raising, or alternative processing). The change is a direct suppression of a logical enforcement path.
